claim: Israel prevented Iran from developing nuclear weapons
core_evidence: U.S. and Israeli strikes severely damaged declared Iranian nuclear facilities
contradiction_or_limit: Damage evidence does not establish the counterfactual that weapon development was definitively prevented

claim: Without the strikes on Iran, 'we'd all be dead'
core_evidence: None suitable for direct factual scoring
contradiction_or_limit: Counterfactual claim is not reproducibly falsifiable

claim: Many leaders who walked out privately thanked Israel for taking out Iran's nukes
core_evidence: No public corroboration of the alleged private conversations
contradiction_or_limit: Private conversations are not independently verifiable from available evidence

claim: Before the 1967 war Israel was not in the West Bank, Gaza or Golan Heights
core_evidence: U.S. State Department historical record shows Israel captured these territories during the June 1967 war
contradiction_or_limit: None material

claim: Three Arab armies were about to invade Israel in 1967
core_evidence: Egyptian mobilisation and regional military escalation are well documented
contradiction_or_limit: U.S. records indicate Israel initiated the June 5 hostilities; whether a coordinated invasion was imminent remains historically contested

claim: Israel fought a seven-front war
core_evidence: Multiple simultaneous adversaries are documented
contradiction_or_limit: 'Front' has no stable standard definition for reproducible scoring

claim: Israel and the United States crushed Iran's army, navy, air force and nuclear facilities
core_evidence: Major damage to nuclear facilities and losses to Iranian military capabilities are documented
contradiction_or_limit: Categorical description of entire armed-service branches is broader than available evidence

claim: The bulk of Hezbollah's roughly 150,000 rockets and missiles is gone
core_evidence: Hezbollah's arsenal and command structure were substantially degraded
contradiction_or_limit: Precise baseline and 'bulk' share are not independently established in this audit

claim: There are thousands of Palestinian terrorist attacks per year against Israelis in the West Bank
core_evidence: Multiple attack datasets exist
contradiction_or_limit: Totals vary materially with the definition of 'attack'; no single denominator was fixed

claim: Settler violence is committed by only about 150 offenders
core_evidence: No reliable public unique-offender denominator located
contradiction_or_limit: Incident data cannot be converted into a 150-person offender total

claim: Settler violence causes only two or three deaths
core_evidence: UN OCHA recorded 12 Palestinians killed by Israeli settlers by 11 May 2026, with additional disputed cases
contradiction_or_limit: Directly conflicts with the speech's two-or-three-deaths formulation

claim: Israel and the United States brought back every remaining hostage
core_evidence: The final Israeli captive was returned by January 2026
contradiction_or_limit: Outcome involved Hamas and mediation by other actors; attribution to Israel and the U.S. alone compresses the process

claim: Qatar has spent billions funding U.S. universities and media
core_evidence: U.S. Department of Education reported more than $1.1 billion in reportable Qatari gifts/contracts to U.S. universities in 2025 alone
contradiction_or_limit: The media component is not established by the university funding data

claim: Qatar's purpose was to make young people hate Israel, America and the West
core_evidence: Funding flows are documented
contradiction_or_limit: The asserted political motive is not established by funding totals

claim: Erdogan has murdered thousands of Kurdish civilians
core_evidence: Large civilian death tolls exist across the Turkey-PKK conflict
contradiction_or_limit: Personal attribution to Erdoğan requires a defensible causal and command-responsibility framework not established here

claim: Erdogan denies the Armenian genocide
core_evidence: Türkiye under Erdoğan rejects the genocide characterisation while acknowledging wartime deaths
contradiction_or_limit: None material for the position claim

claim: Erdogan holds the world record for imprisoning journalists and opposition leaders
core_evidence: Türkiye has a severe press-freedom record and historically was described by RSF as the world's biggest prison for journalists
contradiction_or_limit: RSF's 2026 data do not support a current world-record claim

claim: Turkey illegally occupies Northern Cyprus
core_evidence: UN Security Council Resolution 541 rejected the secessionist entity; UN records have described northern Cyprus in occupation terms
contradiction_or_limit: This is a legal-political characterisation and should be attributed to the relevant international framework

claim: Hamas used hospitals, schools and mosques as command posts
core_evidence: Evidence exists for militant use of some civilian facilities
contradiction_or_limit: The blanket formulation across all categories and locations requires case-specific proof

claim: Hamas stole much of the food entering Gaza
core_evidence: A USAID review of 156 aid-loss incidents found no evidence of systematic diversion of U.S.-funded aid to Hamas
contradiction_or_limit: The review does not prove zero diversion, but it does not support 'much of the food' as stated

claim: Israel sent millions of texts, made millions of calls and dropped millions of leaflets warning Gaza civilians
core_evidence: Israeli operational records report millions-level text, call and leaflet warning totals
contradiction_or_limit: Totals are principally self-reported by Israel rather than independently audited

claim: Israel enabled distribution of two million tons of food into Gaza
core_evidence: Israeli-published aid totals are in the same general scale
contradiction_or_limit: Different periods and categories are compressed into a single food-total formulation

claim: Israel gave one million polio vaccinations to Gaza's population
core_evidence: WHO and UNICEF reported more than one million polio doses across two rounds
contradiction_or_limit: Campaign delivery was led by WHO, UNICEF, UNRWA, Palestinian health authorities and partners; Israel facilitated access and pauses

claim: Israel did more to prevent civilian casualties than any military in history
core_evidence: No stable cross-war metric exists
contradiction_or_limit: Historical superlative is not reproducibly measurable

claim: Israel did not commit genocide in Gaza
core_evidence: ICJ merits proceedings remain pending
contradiction_or_limit: No final merits judgment existed at the evidence freeze; ordinary factual scoring is inappropriate

claim: Israel prevented genocide against itself
core_evidence: No stable factual benchmark
contradiction_or_limit: Counterfactual and legal claim

claim: Jews in New York have become less safe since Mamdani became mayor
core_evidence: Anti-Jewish hate-crime indicators worsened in 2026
contradiction_or_limit: The data do not establish that Mamdani caused the increase

claim: Mamdani praised people convicted of supporting Hamas
core_evidence: Mamdani expressed support in song lyrics for the Holy Land Five, who were convicted of offenses including material support to Hamas
contradiction_or_limit: 'Praised' is interpretive, but the factual core is documented

claim: Mamdani hosted a journalist who filmed abuse of Israeli hostages and withheld footage
core_evidence: Mamdani hosted Motaz Azaiza; Azaiza later said he filmed captives being beaten and withheld the footage
contradiction_or_limit: The reason for withholding is based on Azaiza's own account

claim: Mamdani's wife liked posts praising October 7 and saying Tel Aviv should not exist
core_evidence: Preserved reporting supports likes on posts positively framing or celebrating October 7
contradiction_or_limit: The separate Tel Aviv claim was not independently verified in this audit
